header.purpose: Machine-readable prerequisite gate for ANY future production write capability. A write capability can never be registered in production until every prerequisite below is PASS; otherwise the write must not be registered. This is the frozen CP8 gate for future CP9+ write enablement.

prerequisites.name: approval policy PASS
prerequisites.requirement: the write capability passes the CP7 fail-closed risk approval policy (binding digest, durable single-use grants, consume-before-spawn)
prerequisites.verification: CP7 regression suite + native approval store tests

prerequisites.name: native execution binding PASS
prerequisites.requirement: a compiled native ExecutionBinding exists behind the CP3 containment runner (trusted executable candidates, cwd/env allowlists, output bounds, process-tree kill, secret redaction)

prerequisites.name: trusted receipt PASS
prerequisites.requirement: every execution persists a native receipt (accepted -> spawn_started -> completed lifecycle, digest integrity, crash recovery to unknown_after_crash)

prerequisites.name: complete readback mapping PASS
prerequisites.requirement: the write capability has a mapped read-only verification capability and a registered read_only/low/L0 verifier binding whose outputs parse into the structured observation envelope

prerequisites.name: deterministic evaluator PASS
prerequisites.requirement: a trusted deterministic OutcomeEvaluatorV1 is registered that derives the expectation from the approved plan and evaluates the observation without LLM/predicates

prerequisites.name: subject locator PASS
prerequisites.requirement: the observation subject_key is derivable from trusted inputs and the post-state can be located exactly; stdout URLs are locator candidates at most

prerequisites.name: no unresolved verification gap
prerequisites.requirement: no LOCATOR_GAP / READBACK_CAPABILITY_GAP / structured-field gap remains for the planned effect (see cp8-github-readback-catalog.json)

github.issue.create.reason: gh issue create stdout URL is at most a locator candidate, never verified truth; a trusted structured issue-number field is required before enablement

github.issue.comment.reason: current github.issue.read cannot completely verify a comment; a read-only comments.fetch capability is required

github.issue.close.future_requirement: exact issue identity + state CLOSED via github.issue.read
github.issue.close.note: enablement still requires ALL prerequisites above

github.pr.merge.reason: pr.read state MERGED verifies merge state today; merge metadata (mergedAt/mergeCommit oid) remains a structured-field gap
github.pr.merge.future_requirement: exact PR identity + MERGED; metadata after read field extension

cp8_facts.note: all four remain UNREGISTERED in production; CP8 does not add github.issue.create / github.issue.comment / github.issue.close / github.pr.merge bindings
